ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, in equilateral triangle $ABC$, we have $AB=2$. Let $BD$ be the altitude to side $AC$. Extend $BC$ to point $E$ such that $CE=CD$. What is the length of $BE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since triangle $ABC$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
we have $BC=AC=2$,\\
and since $BD$ is the altitude of side $AC$,\\
we have $DC=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 2=1$,\\
thus $CE=CD=1$,\\
therefore $BE=BC+CE=2+1=\boxed{3}$.
